Container.Name: SubtitleEdit
Container.Overview: Subtitle Edit with browser-based VNC, browser audio, and NVIDIA GPU passthrough.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Browser desktop with audio (no extra audio port required)

Config.Name: Media files
Config.Description: Media and subtitle files accessible in the container

Config.Name: DRI devices
Config.Description: Intel/AMD GPU devices for Vulkan acceleration (optional; host drivers required)

Config.Name: VNC password
Config.Description: Leave blank for passwordless VNC; VNC password limited to 8 characters

Config.Name: Browser audio
Config.Description: Stream application audio through the browser Web UI

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA devices exposed by the host runtime

Config.Name: Unraid user ID
Config.Description: Run as Unraid nobody (99); override to match media-file owner if needed

Config.Name: Unraid group ID
Config.Description: Run as Unraid users (100); override to match media-file group if needed
